location.zh: 深夜，顶级危机公关公司会议室，落地窗外是雨夜城市霓虹
location.en: Late-night crisis PR agency conference room with rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling windows and neon city lights

lighting.zh: 冷蓝色电脑屏光映在玻璃桌面上，窗外霓虹和雨痕形成压迫感，人物脸部半明半暗
lighting.en: Cold blue monitor glow reflected on a glass table, neon rain streaks outside, half-lit faces with high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她冷静合上委托文件，正要拒绝天价公关案，忽然抬眼看向走进会议室的男人，鼻翼轻动，眼神骤然变冷
action.en: She calmly closes the commission file, about to refuse the high-priced PR case, then looks up at the man entering the room, subtly inhales, her gaze turning cold

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，身形高挑挺拔，轮廓冷峻，黑色短发向后梳理，身穿深炭灰定制西装、黑色衬衫、无领带，左手戴银色机械腕表，气场克制压迫
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, tall and upright, severe facial contours, slicked-back short black hair, dark charcoal bespoke suit, black shirt, no tie, silver mechanical wristwatch on his left wrist, controlled and intimidating presence

action.zh: 他把外套搭在椅背上，沉默站定，身上残留的医用级过氧乙酸消毒水味让苏清妤瞬间僵住
action.en: He drapes his coat over a chair and stands in silence, the lingering medical-grade peracetic acid disinfectant scent making Su Qingyu freeze

camera_movement.zh: 从文件特写慢速上摇到苏清妤眼睛，再快速切到顾宴臣西装袖口的雨滴
camera_movement.en: Slow tilt-up from the document close-up to Su Qingyu's eyes, then a sharp cut to raindrops on Gu Yanchen's suit cuff

audio_cue.zh: 低频压迫弦乐，雨声敲窗，苏清妤吸气声被放大，结尾一记沉闷心跳
audio_cue.en: Low-frequency tense strings, rain tapping against glass, amplified inhale from Su Qingyu, ending with a muffled heartbeat hit

location.zh: 顾氏集团地下停车场，黑色商务车旁，水泥墙面潮湿冰冷
location.en: Gu Group underground parking garage beside a black executive sedan, damp concrete walls and cold industrial air

lighting.zh: 顶灯忽明忽暗，车灯切出锋利光束，地面水迹反射出诡异冷光
lighting.en: Flickering overhead fluorescents, sharp beams from car headlights, wet concrete reflections creating an eerie cold sheen

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她拿着前妻坠楼资料站在车旁，指尖划过疗养院入住记录，神情冷静却暗藏戒备
action.en: She stands beside the car holding the ex-wife death file, her fingertip tracing a sanatorium admission record, calm yet guarded

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，身形高挑挺拔，轮廓冷峻，黑色短发向后梳理，身穿深炭灰定制西装、黑色衬衫、无领带，左手戴银色机械腕表，气场克制压迫
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, tall and upright, severe facial contours, slicked-back short black hair, dark charcoal bespoke suit, black shirt, no tie, silver mechanical wristwatch on his left wrist, controlled and intimidating presence

action.zh: 他从阴影里走近，低声打断她的调查，目光像审讯一样落在她脸上
action.en: He steps out of the shadows, quietly interrupts her investigation, his gaze landing on her face like an interrogation

camera_movement.zh: 手持跟拍苏清妤翻资料，随后横移露出顾宴臣站在车灯后方
camera_movement.en: Handheld tracking on Su Qingyu reviewing files, then lateral reveal of Gu Yanchen standing behind the headlights

audio_cue.zh: 空旷停车场回声，远处电流滋滋声，顾宴臣台词前音乐骤停
audio_cue.en: Hollow garage reverb, distant electrical buzzing, music abruptly dropping before Gu Yanchen's line

location.zh: 白天，顾氏集团发布会大厅，媒体长枪短炮与巨型舆情屏幕包围讲台
location.en: Daytime Gu Group press hall, podium surrounded by cameras, microphones, and a giant public-opinion analytics screen

lighting.zh: 高亮新闻发布会灯光刺眼，屏幕红色热搜数据在人物脸上跳动
lighting.en: Harsh press-conference key lights, red trending-topic data flickering across faces from the LED wall

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她站在屏幕前，当众逐帧拆解家暴视频剪辑痕迹，冷声指出水军矩阵的统一发布时间
action.en: She stands before the screen, publicly dissecting edit marks frame by frame and coldly exposing the synchronized posting time of the bot network

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，短黑发利落贴耳，身穿墨绿色风衣、白色T恤、深色牛仔裤，胸前挂记者证，右手常握黑色录音笔，眼神聪明但疲惫
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman with neat ear-length black hair, moss-green trench coat, white T-shirt, dark jeans, press badge on her chest, often holding a black voice recorder in her right hand, intelligent yet tired eyes

action.zh: 她站在媒体区最外侧，看到自己媒体账号出现在追踪结果上，脸色瞬间发白
action.en: She stands at the edge of the press area, her face turning pale as her own media account appears in the tracking results

camera_movement.zh: 快速推近舆情屏幕上的账号名单，再甩镜到沈知夏震惊的脸
camera_movement.en: Fast push-in on the account list on the public-opinion screen, then whip-pan to Shen Zhixia's shocked face

audio_cue.zh: 密集快门声、记者低语声、数据弹窗音效，账号出现时加入尖锐电子音
audio_cue.en: Rapid camera shutters, murmuring reporters, digital notification ticks, with a sharp electronic sting when the account appears

location.zh: 雨后街边咖啡馆角落，玻璃外是模糊车流，桌上放着两杯未动的黑咖啡
location.en: Corner booth in a post-rain street cafe, blurred traffic outside the glass, two untouched black coffees on the table

lighting.zh: 室内暖光与窗外冷雨光交错，亲密空间里透出不安裂痕
lighting.en: Warm interior practicals crossing with cold rainy window light, creating unease within an intimate space

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她靠近沈知夏的袖口轻轻吸气，闻到疗养院消毒水味后，眼神从信任变成审视
action.en: She leans near Shen Zhixia's cuff and subtly inhales; after detecting sanatorium disinfectant, her eyes shift from trust to scrutiny

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，短黑发利落贴耳，身穿墨绿色风衣、白色T恤、深色牛仔裤，胸前挂记者证，右手常握黑色录音笔，眼神聪明但疲惫
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman with neat ear-length black hair, moss-green trench coat, white T-shirt, dark jeans, press badge on her chest, often holding a black voice recorder in her right hand, intelligent yet tired eyes

action.zh: 她慌乱解释账号被盗，手指紧紧攥住录音笔，杯中咖啡微微震动
action.en: She anxiously explains the account was hacked, fingers clenching the recorder, the coffee cup trembling slightly

camera_movement.zh: 从咖啡液面颤动的微距特写，缓慢拉到两人对峙的中近景
camera_movement.en: Macro close-up on the trembling coffee surface, slowly pulling back to a medium close-up confrontation

audio_cue.zh: 咖啡馆环境声被压低，只保留雨滴、呼吸和手机匿名短信提示音
audio_cue.en: Cafe ambience muffled down, isolating raindrops, breathing, and an anonymous text notification tone

location.zh: 私人档案室，金属档案柜成排延伸，桌上摊开十年前死亡报告
location.en: Private archive room with rows of metal filing cabinets, a ten-year-old death report spread across the desk

lighting.zh: 单盏台灯照亮泛黄纸页，四周陷入深暗，报告签名处被冷光切中
lighting.en: A single desk lamp illuminates yellowed pages, surrounding darkness, cold light slicing across the signature line

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她用放大镜比对死亡报告签字，发现笔迹伪造，手背青筋微微绷起
action.en: She compares the death-report signature with a magnifier, discovering forgery, veins tightening on the back of her hand

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，身形高挑挺拔，轮廓冷峻，黑色短发向后梳理，身穿深炭灰定制西装、黑色衬衫、无领带，左手戴银色机械腕表，气场克制压迫
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, tall and upright, severe facial contours, slicked-back short black hair, dark charcoal bespoke suit, black shirt, no tie, silver mechanical wristwatch on his left wrist, controlled and intimidating presence

action.zh: 他从黑暗中递出另一份相同报告，声音压低，像把秘密放上审判台
action.en: He extends an identical report from the darkness, voice lowered, placing the secret on trial

camera_movement.zh: 死亡报告签名极近特写，镜头随顾宴臣的手平移到第二份报告
camera_movement.en: Extreme close-up on the death-report signature, camera sliding with Gu Yanchen's hand to reveal the second report

audio_cue.zh: 纸张摩擦声、台灯电流声、低沉悬疑鼓点，报告重叠时出现低频轰鸣
audio_cue.en: Paper rustle, desk-lamp electrical hum, low suspense percussion, deep sub-bass swell as the reports overlap

location.zh: 顾氏集团顶层空中走廊，玻璃两侧俯瞰城市夜景
location.en: Top-floor skybridge inside Gu Group headquarters overlooking the city at night through glass walls

lighting.zh: 城市霓虹从脚下反射上来，冷白走廊灯拉长两人的影子
lighting.en: City neon reflecting upward from below, cold white corridor lights stretching both shadows

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她伸手接过合作协议，却没有松开警惕，目光锋利地盯着顾宴臣
action.en: She takes the temporary alliance agreement without lowering her guard, staring sharply at Gu Yanchen

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，身形高挑挺拔，轮廓冷峻，黑色短发向后梳理，身穿深炭灰定制西装、黑色衬衫、无领带，左手戴银色机械腕表，气场克制压迫
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, tall and upright, severe facial contours, slicked-back short black hair, dark charcoal bespoke suit, black shirt, no tie, silver mechanical wristwatch on his left wrist, controlled and intimidating presence

action.zh: 他隔着一纸协议低声提醒她，身边有人正在替幕后者盯着她
action.en: Across the thin agreement paper, he warns her in a low voice that someone close to her is watching for the hidden operators

camera_movement.zh: 环绕两人半圈，玻璃倒影里形成互相试探的双重构图
camera_movement.en: Half-circle dolly around them, using glass reflections to create a double-composition of mutual suspicion

audio_cue.zh: 空中走廊轻微风声，远处城市车流低鸣，签字笔落下时音乐短促收紧
audio_cue.en: Subtle skybridge wind, distant city traffic drone, music tightening briefly as the pen touches paper

location.zh: 顾氏医疗数据机房，蓝色服务器灯光映出十年前疗养院名单
location.en: Gu Medical data server room, blue server lights illuminating a ten-year-old sanatorium patient list

lighting.zh: 服务器蓝光闪烁，名单投影在两人脸上，红色警告弹窗像危险信号
lighting.en: Flickering server-blue light, the list projected across their faces, red warning pop-ups pulsing like danger signals

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她盯着入住名单，发现母亲名字后呼吸停住，因为身份栏写着项目负责人
action.en: She stares at the admission list and stops breathing when her mother's name appears, listed as project director

visual_anchor.zh: 35岁亚洲男性，温和儒雅面容，金丝眼镜，身穿浅灰三件套西装、酒红色领带，手持黑色皮质文件夹，笑容克制却带算计
visual_anchor.en: A 35-year-old Asian man with a gentle scholarly face, gold-rimmed glasses, light gray three-piece suit, burgundy tie, black leather folder in hand, restrained calculated smile

action.zh: 他站在董事会远程画面里，平静主张切割顾氏医疗资产，语气像早已准备好棋局
action.en: On the remote boardroom feed, he calmly argues for divesting Gu Medical assets, sounding as if the move was prepared long ago

camera_movement.zh: 从服务器灯阵快速穿行到名单屏幕，最后定格在苏清妤瞳孔里的母亲姓名倒影
camera_movement.en: Fast glide through server light arrays to the list screen, ending on the mother's name reflected in Su Qingyu's pupil

audio_cue.zh: 服务器风扇轰鸣、键盘急促敲击、红色警告弹窗提示音连续叠加
audio_cue.en: Server fan roar, rapid keyboard taps, layered red-alert notification beeps

location.zh: 苏清妤家中昏暗客厅，墙上贴满母亲旧照片和疗养院线索
location.en: Dim living room in Su Qingyu's apartment, walls covered with her mother's old photos and sanatorium clues

lighting.zh: 台灯暖光照着照片，窗外冷月光切开房间，形成亲情与真相撕裂感
lighting.en: Warm desk-lamp light on the photos, cold moonlight cutting through the room, creating a fractured family-truth contrast

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制
visual_anchor.en: A 28-year-old Asian woman with refined icy features, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair, ivory silk blouse, black high-waisted tailored trousers, thin metal-frame glasses, an old silver pendant necklace on her left collarbone, restrained clean makeup

action.zh: 她撕下母亲照片又重新按回墙上，眼中含泪却不肯崩溃，冷声宣告自己只要真相
action.en: She tears down her mother's photo then presses it back onto the wall, tearful but refusing to break, declaring she only needs the truth

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，身形高挑挺拔，轮廓冷峻，黑色短发向后梳理，身穿深炭灰定制西装、黑色衬衫、无领带，左手戴银色机械腕表，气场克制压迫
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, tall and upright, severe facial contours, slicked-back short black hair, dark charcoal bespoke suit, black shirt, no tie, silver mechanical wristwatch on his left wrist, controlled and intimidating presence

action.zh: 他站在门边沉默看着她，想阻止却没有靠近，眼底压着复杂保护欲
action.en: He stands silently by the door, wanting to stop her but not stepping closer, a complicated protective instinct held in his eyes

camera_movement.zh: 慢速推近线索墙，穿过照片缝隙落到苏清妤含泪的侧脸
camera_movement.en: Slow cinematic push-in on the clue wall, moving through gaps between photos to Su Qingyu's tearful profile

audio_cue.zh: 低沉钢琴单音，胶带撕裂声清晰突出，最后只剩她压抑的呼吸
audio_cue.en: Low single-note piano, crisp tape-tearing sound emphasized, ending on her suppressed breathing

location.zh: 顾氏集团董事会会议室，长桌两侧坐满高管，实时股价屏幕悬挂墙面
location.en: Gu Group boardroom, executives lining both sides of a long table, real-time stock screen mounted on the wall

lighting.zh: 冷白顶灯压迫感强，股价红绿跳动映在高管脸上，像一场商业审判
lighting.en: Oppressive cold-white overhead lighting, red and green stock ticks flickering over executives' faces like a corporate trial

visual_anchor.zh: 28岁亚洲女性，清冷精致五官，黑色齐肩微卷发，身穿象牙白真丝衬衫、黑色高腰西装裤、细框金属眼镜，左锁骨戴一枚旧银色小项链，妆容干净克制

action.en: She projects evidence of Fu Mingxiu secretly shorting Gu Group onto the screen, calm but devastating

visual_anchor.zh: 35岁亚洲男性，温和儒雅面容，金丝眼镜，身穿浅灰三件套西装、酒红色领带，手持黑色皮质文件夹，笑容克制却带算计
visual_anchor.en: A 35-year-old Asian man with a gentle scholarly face, gold-rimmed glasses, light gray three-piece suit, burgundy tie, black leather folder in hand, restrained calculated smile

action.zh: 他的笑容第一次僵住，手指压在文件夹边缘，低声反咬顾宴臣并不干净
action.en: His smile stiffens for the first time, fingers pressing the folder edge as he quietly bites back that Gu Yanchen is not clean either

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，身形高挑挺拔，轮廓冷峻，黑色短发向后梳理，身穿深炭灰定制西装、黑色衬衫、无领带，左手戴银色机械腕表，气场克制压迫
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, tall and upright, severe facial contours, slicked-back short black hair, dark charcoal bespoke suit, black shirt, no tie, silver mechanical wristwatch on his left wrist, controlled and intimidating presence

action.zh: 他坐在主位一言不发，第一次把主动权完全交给苏清妤
action.en: He sits at the head of the table in silence, for the first time giving Su Qingyu full control of the room
